scope: 47 programs listed by ADEA CAAPID at review; not a directory of every U.S. dental school.

programs.name: A.T. Still Missouri School of Dentistry and Oral Health
programs.visa: U.S. citizenship or permanent residence required; visa holders are excluded by the profile.

cost.label: Annual ASID tuition
cost.note: ASID years 1 and 2 each list $97,266 tuition. The introductory NDS term lists $48,634. Fees and living costs are additional.

programs.name: Boston University Henry M. Goldman School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: Foreign nationals may apply. BU describes help with I-20 or DS-2019 documentation after admission.

cost.label: First-year attendance budget
cost.note: AS I tuition is $101,676; published attendance budgets are $170,235 for AS I and $154,932 for AS II. Health insurance may require a budget adjustment.

programs.name: Columbia University College of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Initial 6-month attendance budget
cost.note: Initial tuition is $74,394. Later-year tuition is $148,788 per year, with attendance budgets of $200,917 and $199,240. International service fees may be additional.

programs.name: Harvard School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile states that Harvard offers visa sponsorship to accepted students; confirm document and funding requirements.

cost.label: Initial ASID attendance budget · off campus
cost.note: Tuition by phase: $50,894 / $101,788 / $101,788. Off-campus attendance budgets: $95,725 / $165,410 / $165,602. Dependent budgets differ.

programs.name: Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry of USC
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: First-year ASPID attendance budget
cost.note: Annual ASPID tuition is $128,547. Attendance estimates are $186,945 in year 1 and $176,008 in year 2.

programs.name: Howard University College of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: Request the two-year IDP budget, including summer charges; the program page does not supply a complete program-specific cost.

programs.name: Indiana University School of Dentistry
programs.visa: Citizens, Canadian citizens, permanent residents and applicants with a valid visa may be considered. Status documentation follows a provisional offer.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: IU describes a program-specific flat fee. Request that amount and its current full attendance budget; do not substitute regular DDS tuition.

programs.name: Loma Linda University School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The school describes F-1 documentation and proof of funding. Confirm advance tuition payments and the amount needed for the visa document.

cost.label: Tuition & fees · sum of three published phases
cost.note: Published tuition and fees: $29,114 / $115,338 / $116,288. Their sum is $260,740; equipment, books and living costs are extra. Confirm the applicable entering class.

programs.name: Louisiana State University School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Tuition per program year
cost.note: The IEDP page lists $92,287 for each of three years. Instruments, level-specific fees and living costs are additional.

programs.name: Marquette University School of Dentistry
programs.visa: Immigration requirements must be satisfied before enrollment; ask the international office which status and documents apply.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: The admissions page publishes regular DDS rates. Confirm advanced-standing tuition, initial training fees and whether resident rates apply before using them.

programs.name: Meharry Medical College School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: First-year IDP attendance budget
cost.note: Tuition is $119,146 per year. ID3 attendance is $196,162 and ID4 is $171,766. Request an updated budget before planning for a new intake.

programs.name: New York University College of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Initial 6-month attendance budget
cost.note: Advanced Standing tuition is $55,620 initially, then $111,240 per year. Attendance budgets: $87,455 / $174,999 / $170,780. The budget and admissions duration descriptions differ; confirm your schedule.

programs.name: Nova Southeastern University College of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.year: Published current table · year not stated

programs.name: Ponce Health Sciences University

programs.name: Rutgers School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: Request the current Internationally Educated DMD budget and preparatory-term charges. A complete advanced-standing amount was not verified in this review.

programs.name: Southern Illinois University School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Attendance budget · sum of published phases
cost.note: Clinical certification course: $44,017.32; integrated year 3: $135,606.25; year 4: $129,225.77. Combined estimate $308,849.34, including published living allowances.

programs.name: The Maurice H. Kornberg School of Dentistry Temple University
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: First advanced-standing phase · attendance

programs.name: The Ohio State University College of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile requires U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residence. Confirm proof and timing with admissions.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: Request the ASPID budget including the initial preparatory period. A current program-specific amount was not verified in this review.

programs.name: The University of Iowa College of Dentistry & Dental Clinics
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Tuition & university fees · full program

programs.name: The University of Texas at San Antonio
programs.visa: The profile allows citizenship, permanent residence and a legal visa permitting study; includes conditional/temporary permanent residence.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: Request the IDEP budget, including initial training charges and resident versus nonresident fees. A complete program-specific amount was not verified.

programs.name: Touro College of Dental Medicine at New York Medical College
programs.visa: Appropriate study authorization and evidence of financial commitment for two years are required. Confirm sponsorship and the published timeline.
programs.dateNote: The profile lists a start before its application deadline. Confirm the intended intake with Touro.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation
cost.note: Touro publishes DDS year-by-year budgets. Confirm the advanced-standing entry term, campus and any introductory charges before applying these rates.

programs.name: Tufts University School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: U.S. citizens, permanent residents and applicants eligible for a student visa are considered.

cost.label: Initial DIS attendance budget
cost.note: Tuition by phase is $60,954 / $121,908 / $121,908. Attendance budgets are $113,708 / $185,946 / $172,535; health insurance may be additional. Confirm applicability of loan-fee allowances.

programs.name: University at Buffalo School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Annual nonresident DDS tuition · summer extra
cost.note: IDP cost page lists $72,420 nonresident DDS tuition per year. Preparatory summer charges and other costs are additional. The page says final costs are pending; request a complete IDP budget.

programs.name: University of Alabama at Birmingham School of Dentistry

cost.label: Tuition only · sum of three phases

programs.name: University of California, Los Angeles School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Annual PPID program fee
cost.note: Annual program fee only. Off-campus budget separately lists summer and academic-year expenses; equipment and living costs make the attendance budget substantially higher.

programs.name: University of California, San Francisco School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: ID2 attendance budget
cost.note: International Dentist attendance estimates: ID2 $148,719, ID3 $136,055, ID4 $130,825. Annual program and other fees are $86,319, plus initial summer fees. Future rates can change.

programs.name: University of Colorado School of Dental Medicine
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.
programs.dateNote: School application page confirms the newer cycle: September 18, 2026–January 29, 2027.

cost.label: First-year ISP attendance budget
cost.note: Tuition and fees: $98,957 / $96,744. Attendance budgets: $152,358 / $142,195. Ask for the Class of 2029 budget if applying in the newer cycle.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation

cost.label: Tuition per listed semester

programs.name: University of Louisville School of Dentistry
programs.visa: The profile does not restrict admission to U.S. citizens or permanent residents. This does not establish visa sponsorship; confirm permitted status and documents.

cost.label: Program budget needs confirmation

programs.name: University of Minnesota School of Dentistry

cost.label: Estimated full 29-month attendance budget

cost.label: Tuition only · full program calculation

cost.label: Year 2 advanced-standing tuition

cost.label: Tuition & special fee per semester
